description.narrative: The development impact of the Project will be delivered through increased access to finance to support the Company in growing its SME portfolio. In addition, the investment is expected to demonstrate to the wider banking sector that SME can also be an attractive asset class

The proposed project is a 50:50 unfunded Risk Sharing Facility (RSF) on an aggregate portfolio of up to US$80 million in equivalent Pakistani Rupees (PKR) (including up to US$40 million in equivalent PKR for IFCs own account) with Habib Metropolitan Bank Limited (HMBL or the Bank), an existing IFC client, to support HMBLs ambition to enhance on-lending to Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) across Pakistan, with a 20% carve out for Agribusiness SMEs (the Project). The total proposed tenor is up to 6 years, consisting of a 3-year ramp-up, and a clean-up period of 3 years starting after the ramp-up period.
